fn.en: Give instructions step by step and describe things with opposite adjectives.

lines: The door doesn’t open. Don’t [push|press|pull] it — [pull|push|turn] it. ⬅️
[Press|Push|Pull] the button and [wait|open|turn] for five seconds. 👆⏳
[Turn|Press|Cross] the handle to the right and [open|close|wait] the door. 🔄
The machine is very [noisy|quiet|light], so [close|open|press] the kitchen door first. 🔊
The box is [heavy|light|small] — [don’t|not|no] carry it alone. 🏋

sub.en: Look at the instructions. Is there a person before the verb?

items.why: An instruction is the plain verb with no person: Press the button.
The negative is don’t + the plain verb — for every person.

items.q: First ___ the box, then turn it over.

acts.title: Thirty seconds, three problems solved
text: CLIP 1 — A DOOR THAT WON’T OPEN. First, don’t push it. Nearly every door in this building opens the other way. Pull the handle towards you and turn it slowly to the right. If it’s still closed, wait five seconds and try again. Don’t use your shoulder.

CLIP 2 — A CLEAN WHITE SHIRT IN TWO MINUTES. First, don’t put the dirty shirt in the machine with everything else. Wash it alone in cold water. Then hang it in a bright room, but not in the sun. Finally, don’t forget to close the window — the street is dirty.

CLIP 3 — A HEAVY BOX AND ONE PERSON. Don’t carry it. Push it along the floor, and if the floor is old, put a carpet under it first. Next, open both doors before you start. Tip: a heavy box is easy if you never lift it.

items.s: In clip 1 you should push the door.
In clip 1 you turn the handle to the right.
In clip 2 you wash the shirt with everything else.
In clip 2 you dry the shirt in the sun.
In clip 3 you push the box along the floor.
In clip 3 you open the doors before you start.

o: First, you press the red button.

The door opens towards you, not away from you.
o: Pull the door, don’t push it.
Push the door, don’t pull it.
Turn the door, don’t press it.

items.sit: You want them to remember to close the window at the end.
o: Don’t forget to close the window.
Not forget to close the window.

items.sit: The box weighs forty kilos and they are alone.
o: Don’t carry it alone — push it.
Don’t carrying it alone — push it.
Not carry it alone — push it.

items.sit: You finish your instructions with the last step.
o: At the finally, put everything back.
In the end finally, put everything back.

write.q: Write a 30-second how-to script for something you can do well: 6 steps. Use First, Then, Next and Finally, at least two negative instructions with Don’t, and two opposite adjectives.
write.model: HOW TO MAKE GOOD TEA. First, don’t use hot water from the tap — boil it. Then warm the teapot with a little boiling water and pour it away. Next, put one spoon of tea in for every person. Wait four minutes: don’t wait longer, or it becomes bitter. Finally, add the milk. It’s an easy recipe, but a lot of people make it badly.

speak.q: Say your how-to script out loud in six steps. Then say two things the person must NOT do.
speak.model: First, boil the water. Then warm the teapot. Next, put the tea in and wait four minutes. Finally, add the milk. Don’t use water from the tap and don’t wait ten minutes.
